newsitem.title: USA: NeoTherapeutics says compound boosts memory.
newsitem.headline: NeoTherapeutics says compound boosts memory.

text.p: NeoTherapeutics said its lead compound has been shown in preclinical trials to enhance memory in mice and rats with neurological deficits or brain lesions.
The findings were presented by researchers at UCLA/Olive View Medical Center, The Department of Biomedical Sciences at McMaster University and the company.

NeoTherapeutics' compound, AIT-082, is a small molecule designed to cross the blood-brain barrier and enhance nerve cell function by increasing levels of neurotrophic factors in damaged or degenerating neural pathways.
The findings were presented at the Society for Neuroscience meeting in Washington, DC.
